title: Tips and tricks (short posts, one idea each)

lessons.title: Ask for the finding, not the fix: why review-first prompts produce better Swift

lessons.title: Ask about actor ownership before adding MainActor

lessons.title: "Show me the screenshot" as a standing instruction
lessons.description: Make a screenshot request name the screen, state and expected behavior so visual evidence answers a concrete question.

lessons.description: Record the selected Xcode version and deployment target in project instructions to reduce unsupported API assumptions.

lessons.title: Hooks beat reminders: enforce, don't request

lessons.title: When the agent says "done", run the tests yourself once

lessons.title: Small prompts, one screen at a time, commit between each
